title: fix(electron): normalize test path expectations for Windows compatibility
body:
## Why
Fixes #77

On Windows, `path.join()` produces backslash-separated paths (`\`), but
`LinkIndex.normalizeSlashes` always returns forward-slash paths (`/`). This
caused 9 of 15 tests in `sample-vault.test.ts` to fail on Windows with
assertion errors like:

```
expected 'C:/.../Topics/AI.md' to be 'C:\\...\\Topics\\AI.md'
```

The production code's normalization is correct; this aligns all test
expectations with that behavior by wrapping every `path.join()` call site
with `normalizeSlashes()`, starting from `VAULT_ROOT` itself so derived
paths are consistently forward-slash formatted.

## What
- Normalize `VAULT_ROOT` at declaration time
- Wrap all `path.join()` inputs with `normalizeSlashes()`
- No changes to production code

## Checklist
- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits
- [x] All tests pass (514/514)
- [x] No changes to public API or production code
- [x] Single responsibility — only fixes test path format
